jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE independent TREE sprite for Magic Mail's colorful 2D saga map. Push playful CRASH BANDICOOT-inspired shape language: off-balance silhouette, mildly angular broad planes, chunky tapered bent trunk, asymmetric big foliage masses, expressive shapes. Warm magical adventure, not horror. This is a painted 2D map illustration, NOT a realistic 3D tree or orthogonal architectural model. Eye-level frontal or gentle three-quarter view. Whole rooted tree fully visible, transparent margins on every side. GENUINE transparent alpha, everything outside ivory outline fully transparent, NO backdrop/halo/glow/matte/ground patch/cast shadow. No characters, faces, eyes, fruit, flowers, letters/envelopes, other props, vines, tiny leaves, fluffy spherical candy-cloud foliage, evenly repeated patterns, bark scratches, realism, jagged horror branches, needles, glitter or text. ONE SINGLE CONNECTED TREE, only a few large shapes. Subject: a playful BROADLEAF JUNGLE TREE with ONE strong S-bent honey-gold trunk splitting into TWO chunky branches. Its GREEN crown forms THREE broad unequal flattened wedge-shaped leaf masses, the large left mass leans outward, the smaller right mass sits lower. Foliage clumps have broad irregular curved triangular edges and a few deep large notches, NOT round cloud lobes. Lime highlights over saturated emerald shadows, strong broad color transitions. Two short broad roots attached naturally at base, no floating greenery. Squat sweeping tree with a strong clear directional silhouette.
